definitions.explanation: A member of the warrior class in feudal Japan. Also used to describe someone with warrior-like qualities.

examples.japanese: {武士|ぶし}は{刀|かたな}を{持|も}っていた。
{武士道|ぶしどう}は{武士|ぶし}の{精神|せいしん}だ。
examples.english: Bushido is the spirit of the samurai.

examples.japanese: {武士|ぶし}は{二|に}{本|ほん}の{刀|かたな}を{帯|お}びていた。

notes:
USAGE: Historical term for the warrior class. {侍|さむらい} is a synonym but {武士|ぶし} is more formal.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{武士道|ぶしどう} (bushido, the way of the warrior)
・{武士|ぶし}{階級|かいきゅう} (samurai class)

EXPRESSIONS:
・{武士|ぶし}は{食|く}わねど{高楊枝|たかようじ} (A samurai pretends to be full even when hungry - proverb about pride)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{侍|さむらい} - samurai (more commonly used internationally)
・{武者|むしゃ} - warrior (especially in battle)
